hygieneRows.label: Turn Order Service
hygieneRows.message: Manages turn sequence and active participant in turn-based games.
hygieneRows.nativeAction: Implement interface in a service component

hygieneRows.label: Level Registry
hygieneRows.message: Ordered list of all playable worlds. Referenced by menu and session flow.
hygieneRows.nativeAction: Populate the Levels array with LevelData assets.

hygieneRows.label: Board Runtime State
hygieneRows.message: Authoritative logical board state for tabletop-style games.
hygieneRows.nativeAction: Reference Board Runtime State from the setup object, definition, or feature that owns this route.

hygieneRows.label: Inventory Service
hygieneRows.message: Tracks and manages items for RPG owners, handling stack sizes and catalog validation.
hygieneRows.nativeAction: create ItemCatalogDefinition

hygieneRows.label: Progression Service
hygieneRows.message: Manages character progression, including experience points, leveling up, and skill point grants.
hygieneRows.nativeAction: define progression curves for Level/XP

hygieneRows.label: Scene Guard
hygieneRows.message: Lightweight scene-transition cleanup helper that destroys duplicate active EventSystems and AudioListeners at Awake.
hygieneRows.nativeAction: Place this in scenes that may be loaded after a persistent UI or camera bootstrap.

hygieneRows.label: Scene Fader
hygieneRows.message: Persistent ISceneNavigator that fades to black, optionally routes through the loading screen, and restores time scale.
hygieneRows.nativeAction: Place one SceneFader in the bootstrap or first navigation scene.

hygieneRows.label: Tabletop Board Selection Bridge
hygieneRows.message: Bridge between a board presenter and queued board actions (e.g. piece selection and movement).
hygieneRows.nativeAction: Add to Tabletop board root

hygieneRows.label: Level Session
hygieneRows.message: Lightweight static cross-scene contract for level selection metadata.
hygieneRows.nativeAction: Set LevelSession.ChosenSceneName from the UI or mission selector.

hygieneRows.label: Dialogue Service
hygieneRows.message: Manages narrative flow and branching dialogue sessions with condition and effect support.
hygieneRows.nativeAction: register dialogue nodes in graph

hygieneRows.label: Skill Tree Service
hygieneRows.message: Manages character skill nodes, unlocks, and prerequisite validation.
hygieneRows.nativeAction: create SkillTree assets

hygieneRows.label: Scene Loader
hygieneRows.message: Simple ISceneNavigator implementation that fades with a generated runtime canvas. Use SceneFader for menu/game-shell flows that need loading-screen routing.
hygieneRows.nativeAction: Add to a Bootstrap child GameObject or assign to GameplaySessionBootstrap.

hygieneRows.label: Hub Interaction Service
hygieneRows.message: Handles RPG hub interactions, including NPC dialogue, quest triggers, and scene navigation.
hygieneRows.nativeAction: create HubDefinition assets

hygieneRows.label: Time Manager
hygieneRows.message: Manages global time scale effects such as hit-pause and game freeze.
hygieneRows.nativeAction: Add to a Bootstrap child GameObject or assign to GameplaySessionBootstrap.

hygieneRows.label: Loading Screen Controller
hygieneRows.message: LoadingScreenController reads SceneFader.PendingScene and shows optional progress UI.
hygieneRows.nativeAction: Use this only in the loading scene referenced by SceneNames.LoadingScreen.

hygieneRows.label: Local Session Ownership Service
hygieneRows.message: Provides the local-only ownership model for game sessions, used in offline modes.
hygieneRows.nativeAction: Add to Scene Service Registry or Bootstrap.

hygieneRows.label: Action Resolver
hygieneRows.message: Resolves gameplay actions like movement, attacks, or logic triggers.
hygieneRows.nativeAction: Implement IActionResolver in a new class.

hygieneRows.label: Quest Service
hygieneRows.message: Manages quest lifecycles, objective tracking, and reward distribution.
hygieneRows.nativeAction: create QuestDefinitions

hygieneRows.label: Turn Runtime State
hygieneRows.message: Runtime cursor for seat-based turn order tracking.
hygieneRows.nativeAction: Reference Turn Runtime State from the setup object, definition, or feature that owns this route.

hygieneRows.label: Equipment Service
hygieneRows.message: Manages RPG equipment slots and loadouts for actors, allowing items to be equipped and unequipped.
hygieneRows.nativeAction: define EquipmentSlotDefinitions

hygieneRows.label: Vendor Service
hygieneRows.message: Facilitates item transactions (buying and selling) between characters and vendors using currency.
hygieneRows.nativeAction: create VendorDefinitions

hygieneRows.label: Rpg Open Zone Service
hygieneRows.nativeAction: configure WorldZone flags

hygieneRows.label: Participant Roster Service
hygieneRows.message: Authoritative local roster of participants. Bridges compatibility for single-player lookups.
hygieneRows.nativeAction: Add to GameplaySessionBootstrap child.

hygieneRows.label: Movement Module
hygieneRows.message: Calculates actor translation and velocity based on input and physical rules.
hygieneRows.nativeAction: Implement interface in a movement component

hygieneRows.label: Session State Service
hygieneRows.message: Global service for tracking high-level gameplay session states (Playing, Paused, Lobby).
hygieneRows.nativeAction: Add to GameplaySessionBootstrap child.

hygieneRows.label: Participant Spawn Service
hygieneRows.message: Orchestrates participant spawning at designated spawn points during session initialization.
hygieneRows.nativeAction: Add to GameplaySessionBootstrap child.

hygieneRows.label: Character Motor State
hygieneRows.message: Exposes the internal state of a character motor (velocity, ground state, direction).
hygieneRows.nativeAction: Implement interface in a motor component

hygieneRows.label: Pawn3 D Movement Component
hygieneRows.message: Core 3D movement motor; handles walking, jumping, gravity, and ground detection.
hygieneRows.nativeAction: Attach to a Pawn root with CharacterController.

hygieneRows.label: Pawn Combat Module
hygieneRows.message: Handles pawn-specific combat logic, weapon state, and targeting.
hygieneRows.nativeAction: Implement interface in a combat module
